message.content:
Baato’s level-up is a quiet moment on the ridge path. The wind drops for a second, and the cold feels less like a weight and more like a familiar coat. He feels steadier, sharper, and a little lighter, as if his body has finally caught up to the work he’s been doing.

Here are the new abilities granted to Baato:

<npcs>
  <npc>
    <name>Baato</name>
    <abilities>
      <ability>
        <name>Herbal Resonance</name>
        <description>Passive. Recognizes the properties and medicinal uses of common local herbs at a glance without needing to recall specific lore.</description>
        <type>Passive</type>
        <level>5</level>
        <shortDescription>Instantly knows common herb properties and uses.</shortDescription>
      </ability>
      <ability>
        <name>Apprentice’s Sight</name>
        <description>Passive. Allows the user to see through minor illusions and disguises with a chance to detect hidden objects or creatures.</description>
        <type>Passive</type>
        <level>5</level>
        <shortDescription>See through minor illusions and hidden things.</shortDescription>
      </ability>
      <ability>
        <name>Cold Brew</name>
        <description>Passive. Reduces stamina drain from physical exertion in freezing temperatures and improves balance on icy surfaces.</description>
        <type>Passive</type>
        <level>5</level>
        <shortDescription>Less stamina drain and better balance in cold.</shortDescription>
      </ability>
      <ability>
        <name>Quick Tincture</name>
        <description>Active. Allows the user to craft a basic healing or energy potion in half the normal time by focusing on core ingredients.</description>
        <type>Active</type>
        <level>5</level>
        <shortDescription>Craft basic potions twice as fast.</shortDescription>
      </ability>
      <ability>
        <name>Steady Hand</name>
        <description>Passive. Reduces the chance of spoiling ingredients during the alchemy process and improves the potency of crafted items.</description>
        <type>Passive</type>
        <level>5</level>
        <shortDescription>Fewer failed alchemy attempts and better results.</shortDescription>
      </ability>
      <ability>
        <name>Forager’s Instinct</name>
        <description>Passive. Increases the chance of finding rare herbs and materials when exploring wild areas or forests.</description>
        <type>Passive</type>
        <level>5</level>
        <shortDescription>Find rare herbs and materials more often.</shortDescription>
      </ability>
    </abilities>
  </npc>
</npcs>

Baato stands on the frost-hardened path, the wind biting through his cloak as the faint hum of new power settles in his bones. The level-up is a quiet surge, not a thunderclap, but it sharpens his senses and steadies his limbs. He feels the weight of the courier satchel less, the cold less punishing.

Two potential abilities present themselves to his growing understanding:

1.  **Frost Step:** Allows short, rapid bursts of movement across snow and ice without slipping, granting a burst of speed on frozen surfaces. This complements his general agility but is specifically tuned to the environment he is currently traversing, unlike general movement skills.
2.  **Apprentice’s Focus:** Reduces the time spent on alchemical sorting and preparation tasks by a small margin, reflecting his new status as Tsubaki’s apprentice. This is more directly tied to his class and recent training, reinforcing his domestic skill set rather than expanding his physical capabilities.

Baato chooses **Frost Step**. The cold is a constant enemy on the ridge, and a practical edge for survival feels more immediately useful than a minor boost to shop work.

<npcs>
  <npc>
    <name>Baato</name>
    <abilities>
      <ability>
        <name>Frost Step</name>
        <description>Allows short, rapid bursts of movement across snow and ice without slipping, granting a burst of speed on frozen surfaces.</description>
        <type>Active</type>
        <level>5</level>
        <shortDescription>Burst of speed on snow and ice without slipping</shortDescription>
      </ability>
    </abilities>
  </npc>
</npcs>

Baato's level-up to 6 reflects his growing competence as an alchemist apprentice and a traveler in the harsh Frost March. The following abilities are granted to him:

<npcs>
  <npc>
    <name>Baato</name>
    <abilities>
      <ability>
        <name>Alchemical Insight</name>
        <description>Baato gains a deeper understanding of basic reagents, allowing him to identify common herbs and minerals at a glance with a slight bonus to Herbalism checks involving identification.</description>
        <type>Passive</type>
        <level>6</level>
        <shortDescription>Enhanced herb and mineral identification skills</shortDescription>
      </ability>
      <ability>
        <name>Winter’s Embrace</name>
        <description>Baato’s body adapts to the cold, reducing stamina drain from exposure and allowing him to move more efficiently in freezing temperatures without extra gear.</description>
        <type>Passive</type>
        <level>6</level>
        <shortDescription>Improved stamina and movement in cold weather</shortDescription>
      </ability>
      <ability>
        <name>Keen Senses</name>
        <description>Baato’s perception sharpens, letting him spot subtle details in his environment, such as hidden traps, faint sounds, or distant movements, with increased awareness.</description>
        <type>Passive</type>
        <level>6</level>
        <shortDescription>Heightened awareness of environmental details</shortDescription>
      </ability>
      <ability>
        <name>Steady Footing</name>
        <description>Baato maintains better balance on uneven or slippery surfaces, reducing the chance of falling or losing momentum when traversing difficult terrain like snow or ice.</description>
        <type>Passive</type>
        <level>6</level>
        <shortDescription>Better balance on slippery or uneven ground</shortDescription>
      </ability>
      <ability>
        <name>Quick Mix</name>
        <description>Baato can prepare simple potions and tinctures faster than before, reducing the time required for basic alchemical crafting by a noticeable margin.</description>
        <type>Passive</type>
        <level>6</level>
        <shortDescription>Faster preparation of basic alchemical items</shortDescription>
      </ability>
      <ability>
        <name>Resilient Spirit</name>
        <description>Baato’s mind and body grow tougher against fatigue and minor ailments, granting him greater resistance to exhaustion and improved recovery after physical exertion.</description>
        <type>Passive</type>
        <level>6</level>
        <shortDescription>Increased resistance to fatigue and minor ailments</shortDescription>
      </ability>
    </abilities>
  </npc>
</npcs>
